selection.platform: Pixhawk 6X with Jetson Orin NX companion computer
selection.reason: The three native PX4 topic exports retain integer microsecond timestamps and supply the position/velocity, attitude quaternion, and angular-rate observations needed for a read-only event-time adapter.
selection.non_selection: The grouped CSV representation was inspected but its timestamp field is ISO-formatted from a microsecond source with a nanosecond interpretation. It is not used as an event-time source. The complete 2.1 GB archive is not retained.

permitted_use: CC BY 4.0 source-backed, read-only external fixed-wing PX4 event-time replay. It is not an onboard monitor-latency measurement, a multicopter calibration source, a RflyMAD case-identity source, or an engineering safety validation.
correction: Two retained historical CSV files were truncated byte prefixes of the official ZIP members. v34 uses the complete CRC/SHA-verified members; historical v33 inputs and results remain unchanged.
attribution: Cesar Garcia Gascon, Javier Bas Bolufer, Pablo Castello Pedrero, Juan A. Garcia-Manrique. Fixed-Wing UAS Telemetry Benchmark (IDF_DS), v1.0, https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.16992976.
